blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Alas Pilipinas’ Sisi Rondina and Bernadeth Pons fell to Kazakhstan’s Merey Kozhakhmet and Laura Kabulbekova, 21-17, 10-21, 15-10, to end their Pool E campaign in the Asian Games 2026 women’s beach volleyball tournament Friday at Hekinan Ryokuchi Beach Court. Pons and Rondina fought back from a lethargic first set by dominating the second by 11 points to force a decider, only for the Kazakh pair to pull away down the stretch. “We missed the opportunity, that’s all I can say.
